old_caption: The video depicts a close-up view of two hands manipulating small metallic components on a plain white surface. Initially, one hand holds a cylindrical object with a central hole, while the other hand holds a smaller circular component. The hands move these parts towards each other, aligning them carefully. As the sequence progresses, the hands continue to rotate and adjust the components, demonstrating a precise assembly process. The background remains static throughout, focusing entirely on the hands and the metallic parts they handle. There is no indication of any additional objects or characters in the scene, and the lighting is consistent, ensuring clear visibility of the intricate details of the components being handled.

caption: The video depicts two hands held over a plain white surface, with small metal parts—a thin rod, a cross-shaped bolt-and-nut assembly, and a hex nut—lying scattered in the background throughout. The left hand pinches a ring-shaped object face-on, a light band surrounding a dark center. It rotates the object about a horizontal axis until it passes edge-on and settles showing its opposite flat metallic face with a small central hole. Meanwhile the right hand, holding a small cylindrical piece, reorients it so a greyish end faces the disc and translates it leftward and slightly upward. The right hand brings the piece to the disc's central hole, where it seats as a darker circular spot. Both hands converge to hold the combined disc-and-piece, partly occluding the background parts.
